title: Settings
description: Manage your account settings and profile information.

form.emailDescription: This is the email address associated with your account. Sign-in links and digest emails are sent here.
form.emailHint: Changing your email sends a verification link to the new address.
form.fullNameDescription: This is your display name within WakeMark. For example, your real name or a nickname.
form.avatarDescription: This is your profile picture, shown next to your name across WakeMark. Upload a custom avatar from your files.
form.avatarHint: Max file size: {maxSizeInMB} MB. Allowed types: {allowedTypes}.
form.avatarFooterHint: An avatar is optional but strongly recommended.

toast.fullNameLengthError: Full name must be less than {maxLength} characters
toast.errorInvalidFileType: Invalid file type for avatar. Only {allowedTypes} are allowed.
toast.errorInvalidFileTypeDescription: Please upload a file smaller than {maxSizeInMB} MB.
toast.errorFileSizeExceeded: Avatar size exceeds the {maxSizeInMB} MB limit.
toast.errorFileSizeExceededDescription: Please upload a file smaller than {maxSizeInMB} MB.
toast.updateSuccessDescription: Your profile has been updated successfully.
toast.updateErrorDescription: Failed to update settings. Please try again later.
toast.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
toast.emailSentDescription: Check your inbox and click the link to verify your new email.

digest.title: Weekly digest
digest.description: Control when and where your weekly bookmark summary arrives.
digest.enabledHint: A summary of your bookmarks arrives every Friday in your local time zone.
digest.timeZoneHint: Detected from your browser; change it if you travel.
digest.footerHint: Changes apply from the next scheduled digest.

toast.saveSuccessDescription: Your weekly digest will follow the new schedule.
toast.saveErrorDescription: Failed to save digest settings. Please try again later.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.notSubscribed: You are currently not subscribed to any plan.
subscription.footerHint: Upgrade anytime to unlock more credits and features.
